To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Context is useful in predicting user intent, 2) The utility of context depends on the source of the context information and 3) A query and its context can be combined optimally for each individual query to better predict user intent.

(i) we show that contextual information can improve the accuracy of predicting a user's short-term interest; (ii) we show that the source of behavioral evidence influences predictive accuracy, and; (ii) our study provides evidence that we can learn an optimal combination of the query, and its context for each query, which can improve the accuracy in predicting the user's short term interests.
